name: Mateo Rodriguez
bio:
Mateo's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly, watching Formula 1 races with his grandfather on Sunday mornings. Initially drawn to the speed, he soon became fascinated by the technical intricacies. He started volunteering at local racing events, eventually landing a junior mechanic role with a touring car team. His aptitude for understanding vehicle dynamics led him to pursue engineering studies, specializing in vehicle performance.

At Porsche Penske Motorsport, Mateo thrives on the collaborative environment. He believes the key to successful test programs is clear communication and meticulous data analysis. He's known for his calm demeanor under pressure and his ability to quickly identify and troubleshoot issues during testing sessions. Mateo's colleagues value his loyalty and his dedication to continuous improvement, always striving to optimize the test program for maximum performance gain.

What sets Mateo apart is his ability to translate complex technical data into actionable insights for the drivers. He builds strong relationships with the drivers, earning their trust through his thoroughness and his commitment to providing them with the best possible feedback.

physical.description: He has a lean build and a focused gaze.

Has a habit of tapping his pen on the table when deep in thought.
